descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92594 AC 2; UAT 3.6 · “Hospital shows today and yesterday only.”.

Bug B34 · S1 · known

Hospital: recorded '(prior)' transcript rows never expire, and a 5-day-old recording still shows as 'Most Recent' (TFA-92594 AC 2: today and yesterday only)

Tickets: TFA-92594 ready for qa; TFA-94699 in progress · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev

Note: Re-filed from D6 on 2026-10-14 (Quinn): the rule is written in TFA-92594 AC 2, UAT 3.6 and TFA-94699, so it is not open. Bedside '(prior)' rows carry no archivedAt, so the 48 h prune never removes them (convex/lib/transcriptArchive.ts:92-95, lifecycle.ts:167-176).

Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S10 Hospital retention, seeded: no recording from D-4 or earlier and no notes row archived over 36 h ago is listed; typed dictation is listed after 18 h and kept before it

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6a Hospital, the part of 'today and yesterday only' that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12: on server day D, no bedside recording from D-4 or earlier is listed (archived as '(prior)' or left … (UAT 3.6; TFA-92594 AC 2; UAT TC-13 (day-2 reopen))
  • U6b Hospital edges that depend on Q1 (calendar day vs hour windows: a D-2 or D-3 recording), Q10 (36 h vs 54 h in all for typed dictation: a row archived 35 h ago) and Q12 (prototype per-stay history vs … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-92594 AC 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Server day D on the local stack. {hospitalPatient}: three rounding.update writes with transcriptDate D-4 'QA16-RET-D4', D-1 'QA16-RET-D1', then D 'QA16-RET-D0', so the server itself builds '<D-4> (prior)' and '<D-1> (prior)'; a '<Mon D, 55 h ago> · Encounter notes' row 'QA16-RET-37H' with archivedAt = now−37 h; …

When Open the Hospital list (AppLayout ContextLifecycle runs rounding:applyLifecycle with the server's Date.now()), then patient 1's Encounter tab: look without opening anything, open '<D-1> (prior)', open the '<19 h ago> · Encounter notes' row. Then patient 2's Encounter tab

Then Patient 1 lists only '<D-1> (prior)', '<19 h ago> · Encounter notes' and 'Most Recent': no '<D-4> (prior)', no 37 h notes row, and so no 'Earlier sessions' fold. The 19 h note has left the working box and opens to its text. Patient 2 lists no 'Most Recent' (the D-5 recording is gone) and its 17 h note is still in the working box. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From UAT 3.6 Hospital lines and TFA-92594 AC 2, using only the part that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12 (U6a). 37 h is one hour past 36 h: outside the 3.6 reading (36 h after it becomes yesterday's transcript) and the 3.7 reading (36 h in all), and its label day is at least the day before yesterday. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Needs a decision (Daniela) · environment dev · tickets TFA-92594 ready for qa

For a Hospital patient, recordings from 4 or more days ago and notes archived over 36 h ago are still listed, grouped into undated 'Earlier sessions' rows, instead of only today and yesterday.

Evidence: Allure 1f7371f6. Ledger #17 U17: 'Fail vs UAT 3.6 — by design, needs Daniela'. '(prior)' rows have no archivedAt (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95, prototype per-stay policy 4204450), and encounterArchive expires at 48 h. Dev report §3 row 1. TC-16 Q1/Q10/Q12 are open (prototype vs AC 2). The TFA-94699 table (in progress) says 36 h.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).
